name: Entity Tracker Hud
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: ElmerLion
description: Adds a customizable and easy-to-read list of all specific entities near you

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Counts the loaded mobs and animals by type and lists them in a panel at the top right (gui x 242..418, y 8.., one 18-px row per type, with the spawn-egg icon, name and count); no panel while none are near.
note: Not yet: its settings screen doesn't open (no default key either); a mob with no item icon falls back to a texture, which Kiln doesn't draw
